Hello David. How was your trip to Turkey?
It was amazing. I arrived home two weeks ago.
Where did you stay?
I stayed in a small hotel in Istanbul. The hotel was old, but the view was beautiful.
And the weather? Was it sunny?
It was sunny every day. Only the last day was rainy, so I stayed inside and I watched a movie.

Hi Marlene, this is Anna. I arrived home yesterday, and I want to tell you about the trip. We stayed in Italy for ten days. The first week was sunny and warm, so we walked in the old city every morning. On Thursday we visited a small town near Rome, and we tried a new dish in a family restaurant. It was delicious. The last two days were rainy, so we stayed in the hotel and we watched old movies. The people were very kind. My best memory is the food and the people. I mailed you a postcard from Rome. Call me this weekend, and I want to tell you the whole story.

Hello Marlene, this is David. Thank you for your message. I want to tell you about my last day in Istanbul. I started the day early, and the weather was rainy. So I stayed in the hotel and I watched a movie in my room. In the afternoon the weather changed, and it was sunny again. I walked to the old market with a friend. We looked at the carpets and we talked to the sellers. They were very friendly. I mailed a postcard to my sister, and then we tried a Turkish coffee. It was a perfect last day. My trip started two weeks ago, and now it is only an amazing memory. Have a good week.

First, you say where you traveled and when. Then you say where you stayed and how the hotel was. After that, you say how the weather was. Next, you say your best memory of the trip. Finally, you ask the other person about their trip.
